summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine director/PDMR share transactions under the All Employee Share Purchase Plan. The filing discloses acquisitions of ordinary shares by CEO Anil Wadhwani, Chief Strategy Officer Kenneth Rappold, and Chief Risk Officer Avnish Kalra on May 20, 2026, through dividend reinvestment. Prices range from HKD 115.8861 to GBP 11.29635, with minimal volumes of 1 to 7 shares. This is a standard ownership disclosure, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or strategic event is involved.
